sources.collection_caveat: gh run view --log-failed returned empty output. Direct job API returned the log; a failed-step slice was extracted using its command and exit markers and served to both methods. This replay does not evaluate live CLI log fallback behavior.

sources.comparison_caveat: Full PR diff and one-commit patch cover different scopes; reduced scope is available through gh compare too and is not evidence of custom-tool token savings.

key_evidence_preserved: Expected signature including nested function parameters
stronger_ci_baseline.approval_status: The user subsequently explicitly approved the additional three executions. They completed successfully and are recorded in ci-internal.json.
stronger_ci_baseline.interpretation: The stronger gh+rg baseline preserved every requested fact. The earlier window prototype used 1.88% fewer total tokens than this baseline; internal fact parsing used 4.47% fewer. See the follow-up report for raw usage, sample size and limitations.

findings.ci: The initial failed-step comparison reduced total usage 13.71% and uncached input 23.32%. A subsequently authorized gh+rg comparison preserved the same evidence with most of that benefit; see the follow-up report.
findings.reviews: Total usage fell 1.23%, while the optimized gh and prototype interface payloads were byte-for-byte identical. Differences include guide/command text and model output variation; content filtering provides no unique savings in this comparison.
findings.delta: Prototype total usage increased 2.99%. In one gh trial the agent further narrowed the jq fields to the requested metadata, emitting only 433 bytes, while all prototype trials emitted patches too. This permitted optimization was retained rather than discarded.
findings.prioritization: CI evidence extraction is the only tested candidate with a material reduction relative to an unfiltered failed-step output. Start with a skill using gh and rg. A separate CLI needs further evidence for cases such as matrix error grouping, robust format handling or persistent change tracking.
findings.current_project: Current east-true/my-agent-tools had no GitHub Actions runs or PRs available for this validation. Public external repository snapshots were used instead.

limitations: Three sessions per arm and one selected public case per candidate; descriptive results, not a broad reliability or savings claim.
Fixed snapshot replay validates deterministic extraction and model usage over returned data, not live remote collection, network latency, auth handling or API fallback reliability.
Candidate commands are experimental Python prototypes outside the tools github product CLI.

CI quality is checked against four specific facts, not successful source-code repair or a complete root-cause diagnosis for arbitrary failures. Five-line context windows can miss important information outside the retained windows.
The prototype complete_diagnosis flag only indicates that every supplied step had a recognized diagnostic marker, not a guarantee that every cause or relevant log line is retained.

Unknown failed steps are retained in full; empty logs are rejected. Pagination, outdated unresolved reviews, diverged baselines, missing commits, file limits, renames and missing binary patches are covered by boundary tests.
Actual reviews snapshot contains seven unresolved threads and no resolved threads; resolved-thread filtering is validated separately by controlled boundary tests.
Review extraction does not measure comprehension of review requests, code changes or replies.
Delta task validates file metadata and SHAs; it does not validate a code review of all changed patches or a persistent cursor that tracks comments/checks between sessions.
Both interfaces retain complete compare patches by default. Models may further filter locally; the optimized gh delta trial with smaller fields is included.
Both method guides are provided in the prompt and count toward measured input usage; their lengths differ naturally.
All 18 main trials are included, with no retries or discarded trials. Strengthened CI trials were initially blocked, then explicitly approved and completed; their records are in the follow-up report.
Total input-plus-output includes cached input. Output tokens already include reasoning output; monetary cost is not calculated.
Main-agent setup, collection, prototype implementation, boundary tests and analysis tokens are excluded.
Many sampled CI logs were missing, expired or empty. The chosen direct job log is available evidence, not a representative random sample of CI failures.
Raw public snapshots remain in temporary storage; source URLs and hashes are recorded. GitHub may subsequently remove logs or change PR responses.
